summary.text: Scott Kawasaki is a Democratic member of the Alaska State Senate for District P; the Legislature's page lists Kawasaki's service from the 25th Legislature (2007) through the 34th (2025-2026).

paragraphs.text: According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, Kawasaki was born March 20, 1975, in Tokyo, Japan, and has lived in Alaska since 1980.
The page lists a B.S. in biomedicine from the University of Alaska Fairbanks and prior service on the Fairbanks City Council and as a legislative aide.
